track.name: Beware.. The South London Lover Boy.

wiki.summary: “Beware.. The South London Lover Boy.” is a song by RAYE. It was released on March 27, 2026, as the third track from her second studio album, “THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE.”. The song debuted during RAYE’s This Tour May Contain New Music before the album’s release. Blending swing, soul and theatrical pop influences, its lyrics humorously warn listeners about a charming but manipulative “South London lover boy”, inspired by RAYE’s experiences with toxic relationships. Read more on Last.fm.

The song debuted during RAYE’s This Tour May Contain New Music before the album’s release. Blending swing, soul and theatrical pop influences, its lyrics humorously warn listeners about a charming but manipulative “South London lover boy”, inspired by RAYE’s experiences with toxic relationships. Music critics praised the track’s witty songwriting and vintage-inspired production, drawing comparisons to 1960s soul revues and the work of Lily Allen. Read more on Last.fm.
